title: Batch vs. single-wafer cleaning: the evolution from multiple baths to one bath [Cleaning Level 3, Lesson 4 Extra]
excerpt: Learn the difference between batch cleaning and single-wafer cleaning. In this extra lesson for Lesson 4 of Cleaning Level 3, learn from the basics how batch cleaning evolved from multiple baths to a one-bath system, and why single-wafer cleaning is getting more attention. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
